DateTimeRange.description: An absolute or relative date range.

DateTimeType.description: Whether a date value is absolute or relative.

DateTimeValue.description: A date expressed either as an absolute instant or as an offset from now.

Type.description: Whether Value is an absolute date or a duration relative to now.

Value.description: The date, or an ISO 8601 duration when Type is RELATIVE.

HealthStatus.description: The health of the scheduled report as of its last refresh.

LastRefreshedAt.description: The time at which the health status was last refreshed.

StatusCode.description: Whether the scheduled report is healthy.

HealthStatusCode.description: The health status of a scheduled report.

ScheduleConfig.description: Defines when and how often a scheduled report runs.

ScheduleExpression.description: The schedule expression that specifies when to trigger the scheduled report run. This value must be a cron expression consisting of six fields separated by white spaces: cron(minutes hours day_of_month month day_of_week year).

ScheduleExpressionTimeZone.description: The time zone for the schedule expression, for example, UTC.

SchedulePeriod.description: The time period during which the schedule is active.

State.description: The state of the schedule. ENABLED means the scheduled report runs according to its schedule expression. DISABLED means the scheduled report is paused and will not run until re-enabled.

SchedulePeriod.description: The window during which the schedule is active. When omitted the service defaults it. EndTime must be within three years of the time of the request.

EndTime.description: The time at which the schedule stops being active.

StartTime.description: The time at which the schedule becomes active.

Tag.description: A key-value pair applied to the scheduled report.

schema.description: Creates and manages a scheduled report for an AWS Billing and Cost Management Dashboards dashboard. A scheduled report renders a snapshot of the dashboard on a cron schedule, using an IAM role that the service assumes to read the underlying cost and usage data.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the scheduled report.

CreatedAt.description: The timestamp when the scheduled report was created.

DashboardArn.description: The ARN of the dashboard associated with the scheduled report. Managed dashboards cannot be used.

Description.description: A description of the scheduled report's purpose or contents.

HealthStatus.description: The health status of the scheduled report at its last refresh time.

Name.description: The name of the scheduled report.

ScheduleConfig.description: The schedule configuration that defines when and how often the report is generated.

ScheduledReportExecutionRoleArn.description: The ARN of the IAM role that the scheduled report uses to execute. AWS Billing and Cost Management Dashboards assumes this IAM role while executing the scheduled report.

Tags.description: The tags applied to the scheduled report.

UpdatedAt.description: The timestamp when the scheduled report was last modified.

WidgetDateRangeOverride.description: The date range override applied to widgets in the scheduled report.

WidgetIds.description: The list of widget identifiers included in the scheduled report. If not specified, all widgets in the dashboard are included.
